item.title: October Lantern 0.6.13
item.description:
Works on a new computer, with no setup

  • On a Mac without tmux (most Macs), agents Lantern starts now run in the background inside Lantern instead of opening Terminal windows. Lantern brings its own tmux.
  • With no Claude Code or Codex, or one you've never signed in to, Lantern sets up October for your tasks and says so while it does.
  • Agents you install while Lantern is open are found without restarting it.
  • If a task can't start, Ask Lantern says why, with Try again, instead of doing nothing.

Upgrade when you run out

  • When you've used today's free questions or your October AI credit, Ask Lantern and Point & Ask say so with Upgrade to October Pro.

Also

  • Clearer messages when an agent isn't installed.
  • On Windows, the same anonymous usage counts as the Mac, with the same switch to turn them off in Settings.

The Windows installer isn't code-signed yet: if Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click More info, then Run anyway.
